## Finding the dSYMs

On your **build machine**, locate the dSYMs in the build output:

```bash
# Typically under the publish/archive output:
find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives -name "*.dSYM" | xargs -I{} dwarfdump --uuid {}

# Or in the .NET build output:
find . -path "*/bin/*" -name "*.dSYM" | xargs -I{} dwarfdump --uuid {}

# Match these UUIDs:
#   f6b3b8c8-6799-3123-953a-d09d7ae501a4  (SampleMAUI.framework - AOT managed code)
#   87d24fda-191f-3938-8063-4c56f505eb9d  (libcoreclr - .NET runtime)
```

## atos Commands

Once you have the dSYMs, run these to symbolicate the crashed thread frames:

```bash
# --- SampleMAUI.framework (AOT-compiled managed code) ---
# dSYM: path/to/SampleMAUI.framework.dSYM

atos -arch arm64 -o path/to/SampleMAUI.framework.dSYM/Contents/Resources/DWARF/SampleMAUI \
  -l 0x100ef4000 \
  0x1011bc0f4 0x1011bc358 0x1012bb4b8

# --- libcoreclr (.NET runtime) ---
# dSYM: path/to/libcoreclr.framework.dSYM

atos -arch arm64 -o path/to/libcoreclr.framework.dSYM/Contents/Resources/DWARF/libcoreclr \
  -l 0x1023e0000 \
  0x1027c1700 0x1026415fc 0x10254c31c 0x10254c620 0x10256b678
```

The 3 **SampleMAUI.framework** addresses are your AOT-compiled managed methods — these will reveal which C#/.NET method threw the exception during startup. Focus on those first.
